Excellent dog groomers took 3 long haired chihuahuas here very reasonable price,  dogs looked and smelt amazing clipped Thier fur and nails, very clean and professional business and dogs are very settled there.

Highly recommend
First time here for charlie. The girls did an amazing job. He looks absolutely handsome well worth the money

Absolutely FANTASTIC service from Julia’s dog grooming! The lovely Kate did my boys haircut today and I have to say with full sincerity…that it is without a doubt…by far…the BEST he’s ever had. I’m absolutely over the moon, what an incredible service, from really lovely, kind people, at such an affordable price too! I HIGHLY recommend Julia’s dog grooming services. Thankyou so so much, I will never take my boy anywhere else other than Julia’s from now on!

Julia was amazing, welcoming and did my cat's nails with great care. My cat usually does not take kindly to appointments, but today she was quite at ease! Julia saw us despite being quite late, and I was not made to feel guilty whatsoever. We will definitely go back. Thank you so much!

Penny looked amazing. First time with Julia and will be returning.
Many thanks
Anne.

Brilliant. Booking is easy - if you just need a nail clip you can just pop in (no appt needed). The team are really approachable and friendly (it's so obvious they are pet lovers), and the prices are fantastic. I'd definitely recommend them.
